question_to_answer: What is the intended use and who could be affected?
evidence_object: Use-case note plus human-oversight and risk questions
scope_and_data_path: Named workflow; no patient data in this template
stop_rule: Hold before procurement response if intended use or affected people are unclear
claim_boundary: Does not classify a system or prove EU AI Act compliance

question_to_answer: What personal or health data is involved and why?
scope_and_data_path: Assumptions and processors listed; no personal data attached
open_exception: Processor or subprocessor change not answered
stop_rule: Hold if data path or qualified privacy review is missing
claim_boundary: Does not prove GDPR compliance or DPIA approval

question_to_answer: Which security and supplier controls are in scope?
evidence_object: Scoped control evidence index with dates and exceptions
owner: Security owner or vendor risk owner
scope_and_data_path: Product boundary; hosting and subprocessor assumptions explicit
open_exception: Expired evidence or unresolved incident question
stop_rule: Hold if evidence has no scope/date/owner or material exception
claim_boundary: Does not prove certification or security suitability

question_to_answer: Can each buyer question be answered without unsupported language?
evidence_object: Answer row linked to source and accountable reviewer
scope_and_data_path: Buyer question and product scope recorded
open_exception: Claim exceeds source or uses compliant/trusted language without basis
stop_rule: Stop submission when a material answer lacks source or reviewer
claim_boundary: Does not prove procurement approval or buyer preference

question_to_answer: Who owns the cloud or model cost driver and unit of value?
evidence_object: Aggregate cost categories plus allocation rule and safe next action
open_exception: Unallocated spend or unclear unit of value
stop_rule: Hold optimization claim until baseline and owner are verified
claim_boundary: Does not prove savings ROI performance or cost reduction

question_to_answer: What is the submit revise or hold decision?
evidence_object: Decision brief with Act/Investigate/Hold items and due dates
scope_and_data_path: Links to evidence objects and open exceptions
open_exception: Material question still unresolved or adviser needed
stop_rule: Do not send buyer response while material claims remain unresolved
claim_boundary: Does not prove customer outcome revenue ranking or market position
